name.value: Prince Rupert Fire & BC Police Museum

description.value: The Prince Rupert Fire Museum is a heritage attraction in Prince Rupert, BC, dedicated to preserving the history of firefighting in the region. It was previously associated with the Prince Rupert Public Library's web presence, suggesting a community-operated or volunteer-run institution. Touring cyclists passing through Prince Rupert's compact downtown may find it a worthwhile cultural stop, though current access details are unconfirmed.
